description.value: A private resort on 16 wooded acres along the Englishman River just off Highway 19A near Parksville, with large partially-shaded tent sites including 9 directly on the riverbank, flush washrooms, and showers; fees apply and the site is a full commercial resort adjacent to Rathtrevor Provincial Park.

address.value: 1-924 East Island Highway, Parksville, BC, V9P 1R6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active resort in Parksville, BC with tent sites, RV sites, cottages, yurts, and a lodge on 16 wooded acres along the Englishman River. Showers are confirmed via the front page ('Access to clean washrooms, showers, and Wi-Fi'). Potable water is confirmed on the RV sites page under the heading 'Potable Water'. Reservations are confirmed by multiple 'Reserve Your Spot Online' calls to action. Food nearby is supported by the contact page stating 'close to… restaurants and shopping'. No evidence of hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, laundry, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address; values sourced from website
OSM tags are minimal (name and tourism=caravan_site only); website provided most evidence

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites, showers, potable water, and online reservations in Parksville on the Vancouver Island cycling corridor. Accessible by BC Transit from Nanaimo.
